american_industrial_heritage.name: Industrial Heritage
american_industrial_heritage.description: A deep manufacturing base and logistical know-how support sustained wartime production.

german_general_staff.name: Prussian General Staff Tradition
german_general_staff.description: Professional officer corps and operational planning culture improve army coordination.

british_empire_trade.name: Empire Trade Networks
british_empire_trade.description: Global shipping lanes and colonial resources ease supply strain.

soviet_mass_mobilization.name: Mass Mobilization
soviet_mass_mobilization.description: The state can absorb casualties and replace losses faster than rivals expect.

japanese_warrior_spirit.name: Warrior Spirit
japanese_warrior_spirit.description: Fervent ideology stiffens resolve in defensive fighting.

versailles_humiliation.name: Versailles Humiliation (or Equivalent)
versailles_humiliation.description: The dictated peace has left deep national grievance. Revanchism, political radicalization, and economic strain are seeded.

inclusion_at_the_table.name: Seat at the Table (Alt-History)
inclusion_at_the_table.description: Your nation (or its predecessors) secured real participation in the peace. Grievance is sharply reduced and new diplomatic/reconciliation paths are open.

winners_burden.name: Winners' Burden
winners_burden.description: The costs and responsibilities of victory (occupation, enforcement, domestic expectations) weigh on the nation.

fragile_victory.name: Fragile Victory
fragile_victory.description: The peace feels incomplete or unstable. Future crises are more likely and public confidence is brittle.

reparations_strain.name: Reparations Strain
reparations_strain.description: Heavy ongoing payments or deliveries create persistent economic pressure and political tension.

reconciliation_opportunity.name: Reconciliation Opportunity
reconciliation_opportunity.description: The peace terms (or your nation's inclusion) have opened a narrow window for long-term stabilization and reduced revanchism.
